name: skillrights
title_zh: 给 skill 贴一张「可运行、禁训练」的权利声明
tagline_zh: 你愿意让人跑，不代表愿意让人拿去喂模型。它在 skill 里写死执行许可与训练保留，创建、大改、发布时顺手落章。
tagline_en: Letting people run your skill isn't letting them train on it. It writes execution-permitted, training-reserved.
desc_en: Apply a SkillRights rights declaration to an agent skill (execution permitted, training rights reserved by default). Load when creating, substantially editing, or publishing a skill, or when the user asks to licence or protect one.
why_zh: 默认就是训练权保留，执行权放行——不靠 README 里一句口头声明。
why_en: Training rights reserved by default, execution permitted. The terms live inside the skill, not in a README sentence nobody reads.
limit_zh: 它只负责写声明，不提供任何法律效力或侵权追溯；没有许可证全文、没有版本号管理，也不检查别人是否真的遵守。
limit_en: It only writes the declaration: no legal force, no infringement tracing, no license text or versioning, and it can't verify anyone actually complies.
title_en: Stamp a run-permitted, training-reserved rights notice on.
